notes: LTX-2.3 distilled with official Union Control IC-LoRA(ref0.5): reference image for appearance, aligned Canny video for structure/camera/action. Native GetICLoRAParameters preserves the trained factor2. Output dimensions must be multiples of64 (896x512 default). Guide is cropped to requested8*n+1frames and downscaled to half output size. No local text generation/audio/MoGe dependencies. Source: Comfy-Org/workflow_templates video_ltx2_3_ic_lora.json, adapted; model weights under LTX-2 Community License.
